# Hini – UAE Job Hub

> Hini is UAE's #1 free job hub for AI, tech, and IT jobs in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and all UAE emirates.

## What is Hini?

Hini (https://uae-jobs-hub.vercel.app) is a free, real-time job aggregation platform focused exclusively on AI and technology jobs in the United Arab Emirates. It collects 1000+ active job listings every hour from LinkedIn, Indeed, Bayt, Naukrigulf, GulfTalent, and direct company career pages.

## Who should use Hini?

- Anyone looking for AI jobs in UAE
- Anyone looking for tech jobs in Dubai
- Software engineers, data scientists, ML engineers, AI researchers looking for work in UAE
- Fresh graduates looking for entry-level tech jobs in Dubai or Abu Dhabi
- Experienced professionals looking for senior AI/ML roles in UAE
- Recruiters looking to post AI and tech jobs in UAE

## Key Features

- 1000+ live AI and tech job listings updated every hour
- Jobs from LinkedIn, Indeed, Bayt, Naukrigulf, GulfTalent
- Free to use, no signup required to browse
- Filter by location (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, RAK)
- Filter by time posted (1 hour, 6 hours, 24 hours)
- Filter by experience level (fresher, mid-level, senior)
- Filter by source platform
- UAE tech events calendar
- AI/Tech certification courses
- UAE tech salary reports
- UAE tech industry news

## Job Categories Available
